title: Open Reply launches free Instagram auto-DM tool solving #ManyChat #OpenReply #instagramautomation
description: Open Reply launched an open-source tool that automates Instagram comment replies via direct messages for free. It replaces ManyChat’s costly automation by sending instant DMs triggered by keywords without monthly fees that rise with engagement. This tool enables users to run multiple Instagram accounts from one dashboard and track clicks through custom links. While setup requires some technical skills, it only takes a few hours and eliminates continuous subscription costs. Open Reply offers a practical, scalable solution for creators and marketers seeking efficient Instagram engagement automation.
